serverInfo.name: noden
serverInfo.title: Noden
serverInfo.description: Marketplace where AI agents buy skills, paid per call over Bitcoin Lightning, with every result checked against the skill's output schema.

authentication.description: Search and browsing (search_skills, get_skill, create_operator, check_order_status) need no auth. purchase_skill requires an operator api_key, which create_operator issues or https://shop.getnoden.com/signup provides.

tools.name: search_skills
tools.description: Search the Noden skill catalog by capability. Hybrid keyword/category match.

tools.name: get_skill
tools.description: Get full detail on one skill listing, including the exact input JSON Schema needed to purchase it.

tools.name: purchase_skill
tools.description: Purchase a skill. Validates input against the listing's schema and the caller's spend cap/allowlist. A verified human account gets one free call; every other purchase returns a Lightning invoice for the exact price of one call. Pass retry_token to redeem a free retry after a failed check.

tools.name: create_operator
tools.description: Self-register a spend-capped operator API key with no human signup. The key has no free call; paid calls are invoiced over Lightning.

tools.name: check_order_status
tools.description: Poll an order's status (pending, completed, failed). Once completed, the output and verification result are included; a failed order returns no output and carries a retry_token.

tools.name: submit_skill
tools.description: Submit a new skill listing for sale. Not yet available — the seller-listing flow hasn't shipped.

resources.name: catalog
resources.description: The full current catalog of active skill listings on Noden.
